## WHAT'S LaQ?

  1

### Encourages creativity!

Playing with LaQ encourages creative expression   
and enhances color coordination, by connecting   
the various colorful parts to build an artwork.

        

  2

### Learning through play! [...] Building geometric shapes enhances logical and mathematical thinking, while achieving concentration skills when experiencing the fun snap! and click! sensations of connecting LaQ.

        

  3

### Develops social skills!

Sharing building techniques and cooperating with group building projects are fulfilling ways for children to communicate and experience social skills.
